Day One
Our Story

"Healthy Zobo Juice" isn't a slogan here — it's the whole recipe.

DRINK-UP Zobo Juice & Pastries started the way most good things do in Nigeria: in a home kitchen, with a pot of hibiscus, ginger, and cloves, made for family first. Word travelled faster than the bottles could be filled.

Today, every batch is still washed, steeped, and spiced by hand — nothing rushed, nothing artificial. It's the reason people keep coming back, and why the brand has quietly become the drink you'll find at the best-run parties, weddings, and owambe in town.

Registered Business (CAC)

The Face Behind The Brand

Ms. Idorenyin Sunday

Founder & Business Specialist

Every bottle of DRINK-UP carries the fingerprints of one woman's conviction: that quality is never an accident. A business specialist by training and a lover of God at heart, Ms. Idorenyin Sunday built DRINK-UP on a simple belief — that what you sell should be as good as what you'd serve your own family.

Her faith shows up everywhere in the brand, from the "Jesus Loves You" stamped quietly on every label to the discipline behind every batch. What started as a personal standard for quality has grown into a business trusted for thousands of bottles and dozens of events — without ever cutting a corner to get there.

"I don't sell what I wouldn't drink myself. That's the whole business philosophy."— Ms. Idorenyin Sunday, Founder

How It's Made

Four steps. Zero shortcuts.

The same method, every single batch — because consistency is what turns a drink into a habit.

01

Wash & Sort

Hibiscus petals, ginger and spices are hand-picked and rinsed clean — no shortcuts here either.

02

Steep & Spice

Slow-steeped with ginger, cloves and a house blend of spices until the colour runs deep.

03

Sweeten & Chill

Lightly sweetened to balance the tartness, then chilled to lock in flavour before delivery.

04

Bottle & Seal

Hand-bottled and sealed the same day it's brewed — never batched days in advance.
